implementation_review.verdict: No remaining new privacy/failclosed/expiry correctness gap found in source review. Initial concurrent associated-object lifetime issue corrected by atomic retained association. Device behavior/performance remains unverified by this subtask.

differences_from_initial_design: Strong references, not weak; bounded single proof per adapter, no projection/policy back-reference to adapter, no ownership cycle. Atomic association retains returned proof while concurrent clears happen.
ModelRevision and clear on every native invalidation are conservative; immutable projection reuse after an ordinary model event will scan again.
Account-changed branch calls invalidateNativeSnapshot, also increasing modelRevision.

reviewed_guards.finding: Fresh snapshot/prechecks always run; blocked/invalid/retry/epoch/account mismatch cannot cache-hit; known version0 remains allowed; exact policy object identity also binds immutable names.
Native display-scope layout and original postcheck always run. Expiry before entry misses; expiry inside layout changes current snapshot/revision and takes existing shield branch.

Success stamp only after original mismatch branch returns safely, tied to scanned projection/table and stable model/epoch/policy signature; reentrant replacements never inherit old proof. Stored weak table identity also prevents reusing a proof across a table swap between calls.
All six proof association stores/clears use atomic OBJC_ASSOCIATION_RETAIN; main-thread getter can race background native invalidation without nonatomic returned-object lifetime gap.
A clear/increment interleave can only leave an obsolete modelRevision proof that later fails admission; immutable membership proof is not broadened.
